summary.headline: The World’s First Foundation in Cancer
summary.text: Discussion of the world's first foundation in Cancer and the instability, dissolution, and reconstitution of cosmic things, challenging how this could be known before the stars and zodiac existed. The argument cites Caiaphas, Isaiah, Basil, and Job, including Job's questions about the earth's foundations and measurements.
